project: JANUS Record Drift Observatory / Federated Organism
name: JANUS Infinity Stones — Scheduler Instrument
purpose: Convert recurring GitHub Actions schedule-event materialization latency into five bounded, testable JANUS capabilities without confusing scheduler timing with record drift or inferring undocumented platform internals.

stones.benefit: Treat schedule materialization latency as a longitudinal black-box sensor of scheduler state rather than discarding it as noise.
stones.activation: Every schedule-triggered run contributes one immutable sample when clock quality and timestamp fields are available.
stones.claim_boundary: Observed latency structure does not identify GitHub's internal mechanism by itself.

stones.benefit: Use a second independently timed trigger path for critical tasks so GitHub schedule delay becomes a contrast channel and single-scheduler dependence is reduced.
stones.activation: For critical time-sensitive work, keep the GitHub schedule channel observable and pair it with a distinguishable independent trigger where authorized and available.
stones.claim_boundary: Two trigger paths improve localization and resilience; they do not create independent empirical evidence when they observe the same underlying source.

stones.benefit: Systematically vary preregistered scheduling factors one at a time to map where and when latency regimes occur.
stones.activation: Use frozen test cells and matched minimal workflows; change one factor at a time unless a factorial design is preregistered.
stones.claim_boundary: Characterization describes externally visible behavior only; undocumented root-cause claims require independent evidence.

stones.benefit: For operational tasks, use historical delay distributions to select earlier trigger windows or failover thresholds while keeping scientific measurement channels uncompensated.
stones.activation: Allowed for production/reliability paths after sufficient historical data; forbidden on the primary measurement channel when compensation would erase the phenomenon being measured.
stones.claim_boundary: Compensation is an engineering control, not a claim that future delays are deterministic.

stones.benefit: Attach declared time, platform materialization time, runner acquisition time and actual observation time to every time-sensitive JANUS result so temporal uncertainty is explicit and auditable.
stones.activation: Any JANUS organ making a time-sensitive comparison must preserve the temporal context packet alongside the result.
stones.claim_boundary: Scheduler delay is operational timing evidence and never substitutes for R0-R10 record-drift classification or causal-mechanism evidence.

organism_policy.universal_rule: Any organ that schedules, measures, compares, reports, simulates or reasons over wall-clock-sensitive events must accept and preserve TEMPORAL_CONTEXT_PACKET when present.

gateway: route temporal context without authority inflation
orchestrator: apply operational compensation only where permitted
causal_witness: use temporal provenance when grading causal order
guardian_cortex: separate scheduler timing from record drift
anomaly_lab: generate competing hypotheses and falsifiers for latency regimes
hypothesis_metabolism: rank scheduler hypotheses without promoting ranking to evidence
sensorimotor_mesh: supply independent device-side timing when available
observatory_and_domain_labs: attach temporal context to time-sensitive experiments
operator_hands: authorize external/failover triggers when external effects are required

success_criteria.stone_01: At least 30 immutable C28 samples with clock quality and workflow identity.
success_criteria.stone_02: At least one authorized dual-trigger trial with path-specific timestamps and deduplication.
success_criteria.stone_03: Preregistered matched characterization matrix spanning multiple minute offsets and at least one control repository/workflow.
success_criteria.stone_04: Prospective operational compensation rule evaluated against an untouched holdout period.
success_criteria.stone_05: TEMPORAL_CONTEXT_PACKET propagated into every new time-sensitive JANUS experiment that adopts this contract.
